Trs.

Monster_Eagle
Xavier is a giant eagle atop the Rosymorn Monastery in Act One, alongside his mother the  Ancient Giant Eagle.
“
Mooooother! The plucked one! It speaks to me! Help!
„
— Xavier

Involvement

Act One

Xavier is perched in his nest. If a party member approaches without  Speak with Animals and is spotted, Xavier and his mother immediately screech and prepare to attack them, unless the talking party member passes an animal handling check:

  • [ANIMAL HANDLING] Turn away from the eagle as you approach, indicating that you are not interested in its nest. (DC 18)

If a party member has Speak with Animals active, the Ancient Giant Eagle calls the party intruders and tells Xavier to get behind her. The talking party member can then attempt to persuade her that they are only interested in the big device behind her:

  • [PERSUASION] I'm just interested in the big device, I promise to not meddle with the nest. (DC 15)

Failing to pass a check results in the eagles attacking the party.
